ladder.label: DOWNTREND
ladder.why: Failed cycle — price broke below the low that started this cycle, which historically means the larger trend is rolling over (~80% of cases). Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Stand aside until a new daily cycle low forms and confirms.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum negative; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); last cycle left-translated (topped early)
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BEARISH — weekly momentum negative; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); last cycle left-translated (topped early) (investor cycle week 17 · failed · daily cycle broke its start low 16d ago).
points: Bigger picture is bearish (counter-trend for a daily long)
⚠ Failed cycle — price broke below the low that began this cycle (16d ago)
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)
Daily momentum ~2 bars from turning up
Prior cycle topped early (a tiring-trend hint)

entry.text: Downtrend — stand aside until a new cycle low forms and confirms.
entry.text_zh: 下跌趋势——观望，直至新的周期低点形成并确认。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 53 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_phase: overdue — past the typical window, so a low could form any day
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 53 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.daily_phase_zh: 逾期——已超过典型窗口，低点随时可能形成
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 17 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: late — the bigger cycle is getting old
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 17 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 晚期——更大的周期已趋于老化
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its FIRST half ('left-translated') — weak cycles top early, so this hints the bigger trend is tiring.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在前半段见顶（“左移”）——弱周期见顶偏早，这暗示更大的趋势正在走弱。

ladder.why_zh: 失败周期——价格跌破了启动本周期的低点，历史上这通常意味着更大的趋势正在掉头向下（约 80% 的情形）。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。
ladder.next_zh: 观望，直至新的日线周期低点形成并确认。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看空 — weekly momentum negative; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); last cycle left-translated (topped early)（投资者周期第 17 周 · 已失败 · 日线周期于 16 天前跌破其起始低点）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：下跌趋势。大局（逆势）：看空。
points_zh: 大局为看空（对日线多头而言属逆势）
⚠ 失败周期——价格跌破了启动本周期的低点（16 天前）
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）
仍位于 10 日均线之下
日线动量距转为向上约 2 根 K 线
